content.user_title: Evaluate LLM Applications With Reliable Metrics
content.value_statement: LLM teams need repeatable ways to measure quality, safety, and regressions. This skill helps design evaluation suites with metrics, human review, LLM judges, benchmarks, and A/B tests.
actual_capabilities: Explains automated metrics for generation, classification, and retrieval tasks.
Shows how to combine human review with structured annotation criteria.
Provides LLM-as-judge patterns for single-response and pairwise evaluation.
Outlines A/B testing methods with statistical significance and effect size.
Describes regression testing against baselines and benchmark datasets.
Lists practical best practices and common evaluation pitfalls.
limitations: It is documentation and example code, not a packaged evaluation library.
Referenced resource files are not included in the scanned file structure.
Example snippets may require dependencies such as NLTK, SciPy, or model APIs.
It does not validate benchmark quality or remove bias from test datasets.

use_cases.title: Build a release evaluation gate
use_cases.description: Create baseline metrics and regression checks before deploying a new LLM workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare prompt and model variants
use_cases.description: Use pairwise judging, A/B testing, and metric tracking to choose stronger variants.

use_cases.title: Design human review programs
use_cases.description: Define annotation dimensions, rating scales, and agreement checks for expert reviewers.

prompt_templates.title: Choose starter metrics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new evaluation project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose evaluation metrics for an LLM application that does [task]. Include automated metrics, human review dimensions, and the data I need.

prompt_templates.title: Create a baseline plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for repeatable model testing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a baseline evaluation plan for our current LLM workflow. Include test cases, metrics, pass thresholds, and how to track results over time.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evaluation approach for comparing variant A and variant B. Include pairwise judging criteria, statistical testing, and decision rules.

prompt_templates.title: Build a production evaluation system
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production LLM evaluation framework for [product]. Include automated metrics, human evaluation, LLM-as-judge checks, regression detection, and CI/CD integration.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a customer support chatbot before release.
output_examples.output: A balanced plan with intent accuracy, groundedness, safety review, human rating forms, baseline thresholds, and weekly regression reports.
A comparison workflow using relevance, answer faithfulness, pairwise judging, confidence intervals, and an explicit promotion decision rule.

output_examples.input: Detect quality drops after a prompt change.
output_examples.output: A regression checklist with baseline scores, relative change thresholds, failed examples, and recommended investigation steps.

best_practices: Use several metrics that match the product goal and user risk.
Keep a stable baseline dataset and add real failure cases over time.
Combine automated scoring with human review for high-impact workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize only one metric while ignoring user outcomes.
Do not draw conclusions from tiny or unrepresentative test sets.
Do not use LLM judges without clear rubrics and spot checks.

faq.question: What kinds of LLM systems can this skill evaluate?
faq.answer: It supports chatbots, RAG systems, classification tasks, summarization, prompt variants, and model comparisons.

faq.question: Does this skill run evaluations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example snippets for building evaluation workflows.

faq.question: Can it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. It recommends combining automated metrics with human judgment for nuanced quality and safety checks.

faq.question: Does it include benchmark datasets?
faq.answer: The scanned package only includes SKILL.md. Referenced benchmark files were not present in the file structure.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare representative test cases, expected outcomes, product goals, risk areas, and any baseline results.
